title: The coin that fell on his balance #shorts
description:
At midnight, a 60-cent coin lands on ZERO's $975 balance. Credit card interest is the yearly rate divided by 365, charged every night: 22.36% / 365 = 0.0613% a day. Rate: Federal Reserve G.19, Aug 2026 (FACT). 60 cents a night on $975 is our estimate.

The whole story, from 11:58 PM: https://www.youtube.com/@zerounderstands
